entities.name: Robert de Brus, 2nd Lord of Annandale
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert II de Brus, le Meschin  was a 12th-century Norman noble and 2nd Lord of Annandale. He was the son, perhaps the second son, of Robert de Brus, 1st Lord of Annandale, and wife Agnes.
